scene_purpose: Communicate the extraordinary scale of the event: an incandescent body crossing the sky, not an impact.
main_subject: An enormous orange-white fireball with a long smoke/ember trail, high above a misty taiga river plain at dawn.

camera.angle: Very wide environmental shot from ground level near a bog pool, tilted up slightly
camera.composition: Fireball upper-right with the trail entering from upper-left (strong diagonal); forest silhouettes anchor both lower corners; misty plain and water reflection carry the warm light downward.

lighting.direction: From the fireball, upper-right, strongly warm
lighting.intensity_and_character: Complex luminous core (white centre -> orange rim), believable exposure: sky stays readable, trail self-shadows; warm light scatters in haze and reflects off water; cool blue remnant sky at edges.

foreground_elements: dark conifer silhouettes left and right
animation_opportunities: fireball traversal along a lerp path (fireball().place as in s1)
must_preserve: scale relationship: fireball dwarfs the landscape
warm core vs cool sky split
can_simplify: core to layered additive glowTexture sprites + PointLight
trail to ribbon of fading sprite particles (existing fireball({trail, smoke}) supports this)
plain to low-poly terrain with fog

engine_mapping.world: world({ skyEl: 1, skyAz: 70, fog: 0.0019, fogColor: '#8a8aa0' lerp '#d0a070' by fireball intensity }) — identical recipe to s1_dawn_fireball.js
engine_mapping.fireball: scenes/lib/world.js fireball(scene, { size: 16, trail: 46, smoke: 70 }); path lerp A->B exactly as s1; raise size for this hero shot
engine_mapping.water: flat plane, MeshStandardMaterial roughness 0.08, envMap from skyEnvironment; or emissive-tinted ribbon
engine_mapping.camera: fov ~55 wide, ground-level, slight upward tilt
